WebView2 (Microsoft Edge) page served from the PR's workspace
The running app fills the rest of the pane
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.

Tabs in order: Sessions (only when the PR has conversations), PR Body, Conversation, Files changed, Commits (when a commit list is present), Checks, Findings, Run. There is no separate Reviews or Issues tab: reviews show in the
sidebar's Reviewers and in the Conversation timeline, and the closed issues show in the sidebar's Development and Projects.

Run tab label is "Run · <profile> ▾" when the project has run profiles, otherwise "Run". When the tab is open it acts as a dropdown listing the profiles ("web (default)" first). A 🗑 button at its left end deletes the run's session.

While the workspace is being prepared, the Run area shows "Preparing a workspace for this pull request and serving it with the project’s run commands. This can take a few minutes…" and then a sunken monospace box with the live
setup log. On a failure it shows "▶ Try again" or "Open in your browser instead ↗".

Two columns appear when the content is at least 880px wide. The sidebar takes 26% (240 to 320px) with a 28px gap and stays in view while it scrolls on its own. Narrower windows stack the sidebar under the main column. Files changed
and Run always use the full width.
The title and tabs stay pinned while the tab's content scrolls. Header buttons move above the title when there is less than 320px left beside it.
Merge squashes at the head that was read, after a confirmation that lists what stands in the way. Update branch asks for confirmation. Merge is hidden on drafts and closed PRs.
The suggested errand is drawn prominent (filled). Delete my comments is drawn destructive. Give feedback asks for your own words first.

Findings tab: each finding expands to show its file:line, an "Open finding on GitHub" link and the Undecided · Fix · Optional · Dismiss segments. Below the list sit "Solve findings · N to fix" and a paid-session caption.
Conversation tab: GitHub's timeline of comments, reviews (approved these changes / requested changes) and line-comment threads (path:line).
Checks tab: a passed/pending/failed count line, then one row per check run with its result.
pull_files_screen_new is the same file tree + diff as a standalone screen, with header "#482" and status "Files changed", opened from a conversation's PR menu.
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
